body: APPROVE exact ceb50dc7645cb4b8b49b350a4f8c60055387775b over e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a. The successor resolves my 60d1827 block without widening scope: rights now publish independent Media A, Media B, and coder-annotation coordinates; derivation now publishes independent annotation workbook-to-TSV, recall workbook-to-CSV, and alias-identity receipts; and six counterfactual courts keep repository admissibility NotAdmitted when only one coordinate, all rights/derivations, or all but participant-source authority is established. Full diff remains only .gitignore plus the court; diff-check passes. No participant filename, participant digest, recall content, or event/annotation excerpt is admitted; the only plain SHA-256 values remain the two media objects and coder annotation, while future non-public recall identity remains SensitiveDigest-only. Alias quarantine, typed timebase separation, and CoderAtlasDiagnostic limits are preserved. Remaining ancestor, authorization, and other-review conditions are governance state, not a content blocker.
